description: Kestrel Charging platform standards for every API published through Tyk. Checks the Tyk gateway configuration (x-tyk-api-gateway) as well as the OpenAPI document.

kestrel-auth-configured.description: Every API must declare an authentication scheme in its Tyk gateway configuration
kestrel-auth-configured.message: No authentication configured under x-tyk-api-gateway.server. Keyless APIs are not allowed at Kestrel since the March tariff-API incident.
kestrel-auth-configured.howToFix: In the API Designer open Settings > Authentication, switch from Keyless to an authentication method such as Auth Token (API key), JWT or OAuth, then save.

kestrel-auth-enabled.description: The configured authentication scheme must be enabled
kestrel-auth-enabled.message: Authentication is configured but disabled (x-tyk-api-gateway.server.authentication.enabled is not true).
kestrel-auth-enabled.howToFix: Set x-tyk-api-gateway.server.authentication.enabled to true, or enable the authentication method in Settings > Authentication.

kestrel-upstream-rate-limit.description: Every API must protect its upstream with a rate limit
kestrel-upstream-rate-limit.message: No rate limit configured under x-tyk-api-gateway.upstream.rateLimit.
kestrel-upstream-rate-limit.howToFix: In the API Designer open Settings > Upstream > Rate Limit and enable it, for example 100 requests per 60 seconds. This protects the upstream from abuse regardless of consumer keys.

kestrel-upstream-rate-limit-enabled.description: The upstream rate limit must be switched on
kestrel-upstream-rate-limit-enabled.message: x-tyk-api-gateway.upstream.rateLimit exists but is not enabled.
kestrel-upstream-rate-limit-enabled.howToFix: Enable the upstream rate limit in Settings > Upstream > Rate Limit.

kestrel-operation-id.description: Every operation must have an operationId so it can be referenced from SDKs, the partner portal and MCP tool mappings
kestrel-operation-id.howToFix: Add a unique, camelCase operationId to the operation (for example listPayments, createPayment). Tyk uses it as the endpoint name and as the MCP tool name when the API is exposed to AI agents.

kestrel-operation-description.description: Every operation should have a description
kestrel-operation-description.howToFix: Add a one or two sentence description explaining what the operation does and when to call it.

kestrel-info-contact.description: Every API must name an owning squad
kestrel-info-contact.message: info.contact is missing. Every Kestrel API needs an owner.
kestrel-info-contact.howToFix: Add info.contact with the owning squad's name and email, for example { "name": "Payments Squad", "email": "payments-squad@kestrelcharging.example" }.

kestrel-semantic-version.description: API versions must follow semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
kestrel-semantic-version.message: info.version is not a semantic version.
kestrel-semantic-version.howToFix: Use a three-part semantic version such as 1.0.0.
